release.content: observability 0.3.0 was released on 2026-11-16 from commit a70775c986fd9b5d4fcd2a45cc2d8b6be86e0458 with these changes.

rows: the evaluator and the page reach Google with no key: OBSERVABILITY_GOOGLE_CREDENTIAL_FILE names an external_account credential (k8s/google-credential.yaml), traded through Workload Identity for observability-reader (or a key file); OBSERVABILITY_BIGQUERY_KEY is gone, and the deploy block checks gcp.workload-identity for evaluator and page instead of a key
